title: ID collision detection and renumber
lead:
Handle two branches that each allocated the same ID, per the scheme the owner
confirmed in C17.
findings_note: PROJECT.md Open decisions 4; Risks (merge conflicts on IDs); Milestone 4
boundary: **Not in this slice:** a git merge driver, unless C17 picks that option.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Concurrent `ask` calls on different branches produce colliding IDs (Risks).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: The `store` module, lint, a renumber command, and fixture tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Under C17 as recommended:
- A fixture with two records sharing an ID makes `lint` exit non-zero naming
  both files.
- The renumber command gives one of them the next free ID, renames its file,
  and rewrites links that point at it.
- After renumbering, `lint` exits 0.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Implement the option the owner chose in C17. Gap: PROJECT.md does not say which
record keeps the ID or the renumber command's name; ask the owner.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
